body.x: The world's largest technology exhibition CES 2019 will take place from Tuesday, January 8, 2019 to Thursday, November 11, in Las Vegas, Nevada. CES is a global event for everyone in the technology industry and a high-level business event that encompasses a wide range of industries. It is owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA) as a business place for promising companies to promote their brands.

CES 2019, which is at the center of the 4th industry, is scheduled to run'Eureka Park', which is bigger than last exhibition, and is recruitingcompanies to participate in the '2019 Climate Change Innovator Awards'. 'EurekaPark' is a global stage where startups are attracting attention from investors,media, and participating companies around the world and funded by start-upcompanies and can form new partnerships.

Launched last year at CES 2018, the awards provide companies with technology that can help them cope with climate change to showcase their leadership and innovative technologies. The 2019 Climate Change Innovator Awards will take this opportunity to inform and select companies that have products and technologies that demonstrate the potential and performance to significantly reduce GHG emissions. Winners will be recognized at CES 2019 for their growth potential and technology and will receive the "CES Eureka Park Climate Change Innovator" award in the exhibition space during the Eureka Park.
(Photo caption: 'Wavelite' awarded by 2018 Climate Change InnovatorAwards)

The Committee on Climate Change and Industry Experts will review allaward applications and select award winners based on the quantified submissionsto demonstrate their potential for greenhouse gas reduction. The winners of the2019 Climate Change Innovator Awards will be announced by the CTA by Friday,December 21, and will receive a plaque at the CTA main stage. Companies wishingto participate in Eureka Park's 2019 Climate Change Innovator Awards shouldcomplete and submit an online form by Friday, October 26th.

Meanwhile, 'CES', the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibitionthat can grasp the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at aglance. It is hosted by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA) andis held every January. A global news network that most recently reported theissues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over thelast twelve years, has sent a special report team to CES this year to reportmajor issues in the world market, I introduce to the world.

On the other hand, AVING NEWS, the media company that is most passionate about advertising Korean companies in the world, is planning to launch the CES 2019 start-up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT as a project to help domestic start-ups to advance into the global market. Considering the advantages of CES, which is not a traditional joint venture, it plans to expose promising start-ups to investors, businesses and media through a variety of programs including participation strategy consulting, public relations marketing, and networking parties. Particularly, on the third evening of the exhibition, the company plans to hold a 'MIK NIGHT' party, a business networking party, inviting investors and media that companies have met. MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT is jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and Global MICE Expert Group, GMEG.
